description: The zigordev defaults: a one-day wait, patch and minor updates that merge by themselves on weekdays between 08:00 and 18:00, and a major version that waits a month and for a person.

packageRules.description: A patch or a minor update merges by itself once its check is green.
A new major version waits a month, and then for a person.
A new major version of Node.js is a decision for the whole platform, so it is never proposed.
Node.js and its types move together.
pnpm is pinned in mise.toml and in package.json, and both move in one pull request.
